headline: On the last trading day, Sensex crashed 1,250 points and Nifty fell below 23,100 due to rising oil prices.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 29 September.

why: Sharp spike in global crude oil prices
Proposed regulatory curbs on the insurance sector
Heavy selling pressure from Foreign Institutional Investors
Rising US Treasury yields and global geopolitical tensions
whatHappening: Trans ACNR Solutions and eight other companies filed IPO papers with SEBI
Public sector banks remained open today despite an upcoming nationwide strike
Flipkart projects EMI transactions to drive one-third of festive electronics sales
Mobile phone retailers are planning a protest against UPI MDR charges on October 2
summary: The Indian stock market experienced a sharp decline in its last session, with the Sensex falling over 1,200 points due to rising oil prices and FII selling. While markets are closed for the weekend, primary market activity remains high with nine new IPO filings including Trans ACNR Solutions. Investors are now monitoring global cues and domestic developments ahead of the market reopening on Tuesday.
